text_block_list.text:
Fenomeno's Arima Kinen is just around the 
corner. I want to support her with 
everything I have until that day.

If that's the case, what I can do for 
Fenomeno is—

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: —!? What is this situation!?
choice_data_list:
I went ahead and gave it a full Christmas 
makeover!

text_block_list.text:
In the center of the painstakingly 
decorated room sits a large roast chicken, 
waiting to be shared with Fenomeno.
choice_data_list:
I'm gonna rest as much as I can today, 
Meno!

text_block_list.text:
I've seen Fenomeno push herself without 
getting proper rest time and time again.

"Then I thought, if we make the room 
properly festive for Christmas, it might 
help you relax before the real thing—"

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Just what kind of person are you... to 
spend so much time on this alone...?

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
"...The Arima Kinen is right around the 
corner. So why does the Boss always have 
to..."
choice_data_list: Could it be... you didn't like it?

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
It's not that I dislike it! That's 
precisely why... Ah, geez—

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: EXCUSE ME!!
choice_data_list: Huh!?

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: Let the interrogation commence.
choice_data_list: Huh!?

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: ...Ah, pardon me—

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: I had forgotten.
(CLATTER-RATTLE-CLATTER!)

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
"...A closed room would be improper, so I 
have left the door open. It may get a bit 
chilly, so please pardon me."
choice_data_list: (Taking it that seriously...?!)

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: Your name is?
choice_data_list: ...I'm <username>.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: Your address, please.
choice_data_list:
This is the trainers' dormitory inside 
Tracen Academy.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
"You sacrificed your own time to get 
everything ready for the Umamusume you 
train."

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: Are you certain?

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
We have all the circumstantial evidence. 
Will you still remain silent?
choice_data_list: Kuh...

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: ...*sigh*

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Boss, you are thoroughly good-natured. You 
never hesitate to work yourself to the 
bone for someone else's sake.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
"You care about Umamusume. You care about 
me. However—"

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
If it's a burden that can be shared, then 
I would like you to place some firmly on 
my shoulders as well.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: Understood, Boss.
choice_data_list: ...Yes.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Then please, take a seat on that chair and 
rest yourself.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
I'll take care of the rest! Carving the 
chicken, preparing the drinks... leave it 
all to me!!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Boss. Is that cake inside that box over 
there? May I cut it into slices?
choice_data_list: Please. ...Thank you.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
No. This is nothing. I'll go brew some 
coffee while I'm at it.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
...Boss, would black tea have been more to 
your liking?
choice_data_list: Then I'll have the same as Meno.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: Understood.

Fenomeno stands in front of the electric 
kettle, preparing the cups with practiced 
ease.

"...Her figure looked far more rugged and 
dependable than ever before."
choice_data_list:
I'll do my best too, so let's keep working 
together.

I'll do my best too, so I hope we can keep 
going together

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: —Boss.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: "Do you require another interrogation?"
choice_data_list: No, no! I'm okay!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Now then, let's get back to our Christmas 
party... Hm?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Nakayama...! The lights are on in 
that room...!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
And ain't that Meno's room? Hoh... so 
tonight, she's...

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: ...I smell a case.

Fenomeno's expression instantly shifts 
into full-on "on" mode. Once she gets like 
this, there's no stopping her.
choice_data_list: ...Do you want to chase after them?

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: ...I am deeply sorry.
choice_data_list: No, no, don't apologize

text_block_list.text:
I cover the leftover food with plastic 
wrap and prepare to leave the room.
choice_data_list: Let's continue this when we get back.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: ――Ah!

And so, sharing both the fun of "days off" 
and the hardships of "work" with Fenomeno, 
our time went on.

Fenomeno's expression instantly shifts 
into full-on "on" mode. Once she gets like

choice_data_list: ...Shall we chase after them, Meno?

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: Then let's continue after we get back.
choice_data_list: The rest?

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Yes. You've worked so hard, you really 
ought to be pampered more.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: ...I'm still not good enough either.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
There is so much time I want to give back 
to you, sir!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: A lot. ...So much.
choice_data_list:
...Understood. We'll continue once we get 
back, then.

...Understood. We'll continue once we get 
back, then.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: Gasp!!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Geh. Meno's already here! She sure catches 
on fast!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Damn it! My dream of midwinter ab 
fireworks is ruined...! DAMMIT ALL!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Unauthorized nighttime fireworks are 
PROHIIIBIIITEDDD—!!

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: Would you like some help?
choice_data_list: Huh, Dream Journey!?

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
If I can be of any assistance, ...I 
suppose this, too, was meant to be.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Meno-san is an important Umamusume to the 
girls in the Expedition Support Committee 
as well, after all.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much! Then I shall humbly 
request your assistance!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
"We'll split into two groups! Boss, give 
us orders on which way they ran!"
choice_data_list: Got it, leave it to me!

text_block_list.text:
—And the night deepened. Lively and full 
of energy.

And so, sharing both the fun of "days off" 
and the hardships of "work" with Fenomeno, 
our time went on.
